title: 第9章 正在推演天机第10章 您电子女友的小礼物已送达
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
“哦，原来是这么个亲自法。”
谈不上失望或者不失望，陈怀安伸手摁了上去。
“唔……”游戏里传来一声细细的闷哼。
陈怀安：“……”
好，不愧是小作坊。
他喜欢小作坊。
灵气入体似乎很疼，李清然一直发出压抑的闷哼，额头上豆大的汗珠顺着脸颊和脖子往下落，皮肤表面也渗出细密的水珠。陈怀安能清晰看到，随着运功疗伤的进度条缓慢往前推进，渗出的水珠中逐渐出现细小的黑色物质。
“这画面做的，叹为观止啊。”
怎么说呢？
给一款游戏充钱，不仅要看好不好玩，还要看值不值得。
有些游戏体量就那么大，游戏性虽然还不错，但就做那么一两章出来，整体游戏时间还没两个小时，结果却卖大几百，那不是割韭菜吗？
电子女友这游戏就不一样。
他有种预感，这游戏可以玩到死。
随着疗伤推进到一半，一些可喜的提示终于出现。
【李清然，经脉修复，‘根基受损’，移除。】
【李清然，内伤愈合，‘中度内伤’，移除。】
【开始排毒，请点按‘腰阳关’、画圈按压‘肾俞’，运功疗伤。】
陈怀安按照要求换了俩穴位。
结果刚上手，李清然就‘啊’了一声。
“啧，肯定很疼吧？”他心里默默想着。

此刻李清然的皮肤开始泛红，而且这种红不是在热水中泡久了的红，而是跟煮熟的大虾一样。看把这孩子疼的，都咬着牙憋着不发出声音了。
可实际上呢？
李清然只感觉背后的两只大手非常温暖，火毒从体内排出的过程就像无数虫子在四肢百骸中爬来爬去，又痒又麻，她咬着嘴唇生怕发出一些失礼的声音冲撞前辈。
为了转移注意力，她看向床头挂着的铜镜。
从这里可以看到她后背的一小部分。
本以为能看到一位白发苍苍的老爷子，可什么都没有，背上只有两只灵气聚集而成的手掌，一掌屈指点按，一掌打着圈儿，传来温和宽厚的力道。
没有看到前辈的模样，李清然有点小失落。
心里安心的同时又很羞愧。
前辈确实不是那种乘人之危的人，就算给她运功疗伤都不沾染她的皮肤半点，是绝对的谦谦君子，结果之前她还有那种不敬的揣测，实在不应该。
【李清然，火毒排出，‘火毒噬体’，移除。】
运功疗伤进度条推到底，李清然的皮肤也恢复正常。
不过从陈怀安的角度来看，虽然妹纸的皮肤上附着了一些杂质，但比起之前明显变得更有光泽，就像煮熟的鸡蛋打了点蜡。
“谢前辈帮我疗伤，我已经感觉好多了。”
李清然低声道谢，双手有些不知所措地放在两边抓着浴巾。
陈怀安能看到她羞红的耳根，连带着后脖颈都有被波及的趋势。
“可以问前辈一个问题吗？”
content_en:
"Oh, it turns out he is such a pro-faith person."
Not to mention disappointed or not, Chen Huaian stretched out his hand and pressed it.
"Well..." A thin groan came from the game.
Chen Huaian: "..."
Well, it is indeed a small workshop.
He likes small workshops.
It seemed painful to have the spiritual energy entering his body, and Li Qingran kept letting out a suppressed groan. Large beads of sweat on his forehead fell down his cheeks and neck, and fine drops of water oozed from the surface of his skin. Chen Huaian could clearly see that as the progress bar of exercise healing slowly advanced, small black substances gradually appeared in the oozing water drops.
"This painting is breathtaking."
How to say it?
When you top up a game, you must not only see whether it is fun, but also whether it is worth it.
Some games are that big in size, and although the gameplay is pretty good, they only have one or two chapters, and the overall game time is less than two hours, but they end up selling hundreds of dollars. Isn’t that just cutting leeks?
The game Electronic Girlfriend is different.
He had a hunch that he could play this game until he died.
As the healing progressed halfway through, some welcome hints finally emerged.
[Li Qingran, meridians repaired, ‘foundation damaged’, removed. 】
[Li Qingran, internal injuries have healed, ‘moderate internal injuries’, removed. 】
[To start detoxification, please click on the ‘Yaoyangguan’, draw a circle and press the ‘Shenshu’, and exercise the power to heal the injury. 】
Chen Huaian changed the two acupuncture points as required.
As soon as he got started, Li Qingran let out an "ah" sound.
"Tsk, it must hurt, right?" He thought silently in his heart.
At this moment, Li Qingran's skin began to turn red, and the redness was not the redness of being soaked in hot water for a long time, but the same color as cooked prawns. Seeing how much pain the child was in, he gritted his teeth to hold back any sound.
But in reality?
Li Qingran only felt that the two big hands behind her back were very warm. The process of expelling the fire poison from her body was like countless bugs crawling around in her limbs and bones. It was itchy and numb. She bit her lip for fear of making some rude noise and hitting her senior.
To divert her attention, she looked at the bronze mirror hanging beside the bed.
A small part of her back is visible from here.
I thought I could see a white-haired old man, but there was nothing. There were only two palms made of gathered spiritual energy on the back. One palm was pressed with the fingers, and the other palm was moving in circles, and a gentle and generous force came from the palm.
Not seeing the appearance of his senior, Li Qingran felt a little disappointed.
I felt relieved and ashamed at the same time.
Senior is indeed not the kind of person who takes advantage of others. Even if he gives her exercises to heal her injuries, it won't stain her skin at all. He is an absolutely humble gentleman. As a result, she had such disrespectful speculation before, which really shouldn't be the case.
[Li Qingran, the fire poison is discharged, and the ‘fire poison phagocyte’ is removed. 】
The progress bar of exercise healing was pushed to the end, and Li Qingran's skin returned to normal.
However, from Chen Huaian's point of view, although there are some impurities attached to the girl's skin, it is obviously more shiny than before, just like a hard-boiled egg with a little wax.
"Thank you, senior, for helping me heal my wounds. I feel much better already."
Li Qingran thanked him in a low voice, and put his hands on both sides of the bath towel in confusion.
Chen Huaian could see that the roots of her ears were blushing, and even the back of her neck was tending to be affected.
"Can I ask senior a question?"
